rationale: Fixes zoom registration and stroke thickness of the Flat contact/group outlines introduced by #866 in this release cycle, absent from v1.81.0. No new feature or stable-version contract is introduced.

summary.ru: Обводка групп и устройств у стен не смещается при зуме и совпадает по толщине с обычными маркерами.
summary.en: Grouped and wall-snapped outlines stay aligned during zoom and match ordinary marker borders.
